top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a clean prediction-then-discovery chain: the Bistritzer-MacDonald flat-band prediction at a magic twist angle, followed by Jarillo-Herrero's observation of correlated insulating and superconducting states, now reproduced widely. All three names fit the three-person limit, and the citation can be scoped to the predicted flat bands and observed phases without claiming the unresolved pairing mechanism. P001 is second because it is the more mature case, but its credit is more fragmented (Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang, 3D topological insulators, the 2016 overlap). P003 is a real but narrower invention that sits near the 2005 and 2012 prizes. Any award is preferred to no award.
